_comment: Radio navaids (VOR, VOR-DME, VORTAC, DME, TACAN, NDB, NDB-DME) from OurAirports navaids.csv (public domain), built by scripts/build_world_navaids.py. freq_khz is the frequency in kHz for every type (114850 = 114.85 MHz, 375 = 375 kHz); dme_khz the paired DME channel's frequency; station_var_deg the magnetic declination the station's radials are slaved to (east positive, null when unknown); power LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH sets the nominal range. Region IDs match scripts/world_regions.json.
